params.negativePromptDescription: Describe what you do not want in the image.
params.samplerDescription: Choose from the samplers available on the connected WebUI.
params.schedulerDescription: Choose from the schedulers available on the connected WebUI.
params.stepsDescription: More steps add detail but take longer.
params.cfgScaleDescription: How closely to follow the prompt. Higher values are more faithful but break down more easily.
params.vaeDescription: Choose a VAE that matches the checkpoint type (SD1.5, SDXL, etc.). It is used for this run only; the WebUI settings are not changed.
params.clipSkipDescription: How many of the last text encoder layers to skip. 1 skips none (usual). Some anime-style models recommend 2. It is used for this run only; the WebUI settings are not changed.
params.batchCountDescription: How many times to repeat a batch of the given count (n_iter). A run produces count × batch count images, up to {max}. The seed increases by 1 for each image.
params.dynamicPromptsDescription: Expands syntax such as {{red|blue|green}} and WebUI wildcards (__name__) once per image. When off, the prompt is sent as written.
params.dynamicPromptsCombinatorialDescription: Generates every combination the prompt syntax allows. The count setting is not used; one image is made per combination (up to {limit}).
params.denoisingStrengthDescription: How much of the source image to redraw. Near 0 keeps it as is; near 1 changes it a lot (roughly 0.3–0.5 for touch-ups, 0.6–0.8 for a redraw).
params.resizeModeDescription: How to fit the input image when its size (aspect ratio) differs from the output.
params.maskBlurDescription: Width (in pixels) to blur the mask edge. Larger values blend the redrawn area better.
params.inpaintingFillDescription: What the masked area starts from. Choose "Original" to build on the source image.
params.inpaintFullResDescription: Crop the masked area (plus padding), draw it at the output size, then paste it back. Use it to redraw small areas in detail.
params.inpaintFullResPaddingDescription: Pixels around the mask to include when "Inpaint only the masked area" is on.
params.hiresDescription: Draws at a lower resolution, upscales, and then redraws (hires fix). The upscaled long edge can be up to {max}px.
params.hrUpscalerDescription: How to upscale. Latent upscalers work in latent space; a higher denoising strength (0.5 or more) is recommended.
params.hrScaleDescription: Factor applied to the first-pass size. The upscaled long edge can be up to {max}px.
params.hrSecondPassStepsDescription: Steps for the redraw after upscaling. 0 uses the same number as the main steps.
params.hrDenoisingStrengthDescription: How much to redraw after upscaling. Near 0 is close to a plain upscale; near 1 changes more.
params.hrCfgDescription: CFG scale for the redraw after upscaling. If not set, the main CFG scale is sent.
params.hrPromptDescription: Prompt used only for the redraw after upscaling. If empty, the main prompt is used.
params.hrNegativePromptDescription: Negative prompt used only for the redraw after upscaling. If empty, the main negative prompt is used.

delivery.title: Image lineage record
delivery.lead: A record of the main image and its lineage (source images, generation runs and resulting images), exported from GAKEI. Open this page in a browser with the ZIP extracted as is.

purpose.ancestors: This records how the main image was made (the main image, the images it came from, and the generation runs).
purpose.descendants: This records what the main image (a source asset) was used for (the main image, the images made from it, and the generation runs).
purpose.lineage: This records both what the main image came from and what was made from it.

delivery.truncated: The lineage is large and was cut off at the limit (1000 items). Not every image is included.
delivery.integrityBody: This ZIP has no tamper detection or signature. The sha256 of every image is listed on this page and in manifest.json, so you can compute an image file's sha256 and, if it matches, confirm the image has not been replaced. (Whether this page or manifest.json itself was modified cannot be guaranteed.)
delivery.importedSummary: This lineage contains records imported from another GAKEI (marked "Imported, unverified"). Imported records were not run on the exporting GAKEI and their contents have not been verified.
delivery.graphLegend: Squares are images; rounded boxes are generation runs. Arrows go from input images to a run, and from a run to the images it produced. The thick gold frame is the main image; dashed frames are imported records. Click a box to jump to its detailed record below.
delivery.noRuns: This ZIP contains no generation runs.
delivery.producerOutOfScope: Not in this ZIP (outside the export scope)
delivery.importedNote: This run was imported from another GAKEI; it was not run on the exporting GAKEI. Its contents (prompt, parameters, original dates, etc.) have not been verified. The dates below are the values recorded by the source GAKEI.

omittedInputs.one: {count} (an image not included in this ZIP, e.g. deleted)
omittedInputs.other: {count} (images not included in this ZIP, e.g. deleted)

delivery.footerFiles: assets/ holds the original images, and manifest.json holds the same record in machine-readable form. This ZIP, including manifest.json, can be imported into GAKEI with "Import lineage".
delivery.footerMadeWith: Exported with GAKEI (a self-hosted image generation tool).

readme.body:
GAKEI image lineage record (delivery ZIP)

This ZIP is a record of an image lineage exported from GAKEI.
GAKEI is a self-hosted web tool for using image generation APIs such as OpenAI's.
Repository: {repo_url}

Contents of this ZIP:
  index.html     A page for reading this record. Extract the ZIP, then open it in a browser (no internet connection needed).
  assets/        The original images, byte for byte as they were generated or stored.
  manifest.json  The same record in machine-readable form ({format}). It can be imported into GAKEI with "Import lineage".
  README.txt     This file.

Main image ID: {root}
Exported at (UTC): {exported_at}
GAKEI version: {version}

This ZIP has no tamper detection or signature. The sha256 of every image is listed in index.html and manifest.json; compute an image file's sha256 and compare to confirm that the image has not been replaced.
  Windows: certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256
  macOS / Linux: shasum -a 256 <file>
